# Synthetic report fixtures

**Everything in this directory is synthetic.** The records were generated by
`make_fixtures.py` to exercise `ci/learning/report.py`; they are not observed measurements,
the notebooks, generators, models and profiles do not exist, and no number here may be
published or quoted as a real learning metric.

| Directory | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| `rich/` | Both roles. Design: multiple generator versions, an equivalence change, quarantine, supersession, rejection, stale and `n = 0` calibrations, a model/profile change, bootstrap, provisional improvement, compression promotion, a rejected and an inconclusive candidate, rollback, a pending (`awaiting_evaluator`) comparison, a compare-and-swap violation, two anchor epochs and an anchor comparison under a different profile. Cryptanalysis: one active notebook, a missing tokenizer and an infrastructure failure. |
| `hostile/` | Untrusted labels containing HTML, script, Markdown and CSV formula payloads. |
| `malformed/` | Invalid JSON, non-object lines, missing ids, wrong schema, duplicates, NaN, bad role and timestamp. |
| `empty/` | An empty record set (one empty file). |
| `policy.json` | A synthetic `sigaba.learning.policy.v1` for the report's caps and curriculum thresholds. |

Regenerate with `python3 ci/learning/tests/fixtures/report/make_fixtures.py` (deterministic).
